none: PAS ESS-6448B4: Roman Coin: Nummus of Crispus
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy nummus of Crispus, AD 317 - AD 326 (Reece Period 16). The reverse legend is CAESARVM NOSTORVM around VOT X in a laurel wreath with a star in the top badge. Mintmark is TS... Mint of Thessalonica. RIC VII, p 505, no. 57. Diameter: 16.80mm. Thickness: 1.73mm. Weight: 2.05. Die axis: 6 o'clock
